description: This file defines middleware and helper functions for tenant-based filtering in a MongoDB/Mongoose context, including utilities to filter objects, queries, and aggregations based on tenant ID, and middleware to attach tenant info to requests.

methods.name: isMongooseQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Mongoose query by verifying presence of 'where' or 'find' methods.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Adds tenant_id to an object if not already present, based on tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Adds a tenant_id filter to a Mongoose query if not already set.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Ensures the aggregation pipeline includes a match stage for tenant_id.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets tenant_id on a document if missing, enforcing server-side tenant assignment.

methods.name: tenantScope
methods.description: Creates Express middleware to attach tenant filtering info and helpers to requests.
